extraction_issues.quote: The Nyquist plots of the O-Co3O4 and P-Co3O4 electrodes under the same potential were shown in Figure 4e.

extraction_issues.quote: agreeing with the O 1s and Co 2p XPS results in Figure 2d and 2e.

unverified_issue_candidates.quote: lowered the OER activation energy of 2.26 eV
unverified_issue_candidates.reason: 摘要中写2.26 eV，而正文第12页的计算结果写2.24 eV，两处数值不一致，需核对原文。

self_check: 已核对摘要与正文的关键数值：过电位220 mV、Tafel斜率49.1 mV/dec、TOF 0.39 s⁻¹（η=200 mV）、Cdl值5982/4716 μF/cm²、电荷转移电阻1.9/2.5 Ω、溶液电阻1.1/1.4 Ω、BET 29.15/21.37 m²/g、带隙1.93/1.74 eV，均与原文一致。发现摘要（2.26 eV）与正文（2.24 eV）中DFT计算活化能数值不一致，已在extraction_issues中标出。另外图编号引用（图4e的Nyquist图、图2d和2e的XPS）存在疑似错误，也已在extraction_issues中说明。PDF/EXAFS数据转换的k范围（3.0-12.5 Å⁻¹）、PDF的Qmax（23.5 Å）等实验参数已按原文保留。
